prompts.main_happy:
Production React app mascot asset, main state 1 of 3: WEALTHY / HAPPY. Use the upper wealthy pig in reference 1 as the approved character identity; reference 2 shows the approved compact small placement and restrained style. Extract and redraw ONLY ONE standalone full-body wealthy pig, no app screen, no text. The EXACT approved adorable soft pink toy-like pig: face integrated into a single round compact body, short upright ears, wide oval snout with two nostrils, curved happy eyes, rosy cheeks, tiny brown cloven hoof nubs and short feet. Large full belly, joyous smile, holding one gold coin with both tiny hooves; one tiny golden sparkle optional. No clothing. No separate humanoid head/torso, no long arms, no realistic flesh.
Soft dimensional pastel shading, cute clean app mascot, restrained detail readable at 72px. Square 1024x1024 canvas, character centered with its feet near 84% of canvas height, ears near 16%, maximum content width 70%, leave transparent padding all around. Deliver a genuinely TRANSPARENT RGBA PNG with alpha channel, NO colored/white background and NO checkerboard baked into image, no ground plane, no cast shadow beyond the character. Single complete character only. This will be paired with normal and hungry states at exactly the same scale and framing.

Open simple dark oval eyes with tiny highlights, very gently tilted brows and a small nearly flat mouth: a little concerned, NOT crying, NOT upset, no tear, no dirt, no clothes, no props. Keep cheeks soft and rosy. One full-body pig ONLY. Genuine transparent RGBA PNG, no background, no baked checkerboard, no ground plane. Match reference dimensions and framing, ears and feet at same vertical positions. Maintain cute one-piece pig anatomy; no separate head, no long limbs, no neck, no belly button.
